lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular arrangement of high-luminance circular pixel clusters forming three to four distinct longitudinal rows posterior to the gill slits, with higher density observed along the mid-lateral axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of diffuse elevated intensity that align with the centroids of the circular blobs, creating a grid-like structure of anchor nodes across the central flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant linear feature running horizontally along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition with highlights on the superior edge and shadow on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Concentrated cluster of small, high-intensity spots located on the dorsal surface of the pectoral fin, decreasing in diameter toward the distal edge.
